name: BSoD Verbose Mode
description: Gives more information when you blue screen.
whatItDoes: Configures Windows crash handler to display detailed technical stop codes and driver names.
sideEffects: Shows full technical diagnostic details instead of the friendly blue-screen emoticon.

name: System Tray Battery Percentage
description: Shows numeric battery percentage next to the battery icon in the system tray.
whatItDoes: Enables battery remaining percentage indicator on the Windows taskbar.
sideEffects: Requires a laptop or battery device; not applicable to desktop systems.
uiEquivalentLocation: Settings › Personalization › Taskbar › Other system tray icons

name: Dark Theme for Windows
description: Dark Mode for the system and applications.
whatItDoes: Enables system-wide dark theme for Windows shell and supported desktop apps.
sideEffects: None known.
uiEquivalentLocation: Settings › Personalization › Colors › Choose your mode

name: File Explorer File Extensions
description: Shows .file extensions in Explorer (.exe, .png, etc.)
whatItDoes: Configures File Explorer to always display file extensions for known file types.
sideEffects: None known.
uiEquivalentLocation: File Explorer › View › Show › File name extensions

name: File Explorer Hidden Files
description: Reveals hidden files in Explorer.
whatItDoes: Configures File Explorer to display hidden files and folders.
sideEffects: None known.
uiEquivalentLocation: File Explorer › View › Show › Hidden items

name: Logon Verbose Mode
description: Show detailed messages during startup/shutdown.
whatItDoes: Enables verbose status messages during Windows sign-in, startup, and shutdown.
sideEffects: Shows detailed service initialization steps on the logon screen, slightly changing startup visual presentation.

name: Microsoft Outlook New Version
description: This will ensure the new Outlook application is used.
whatItDoes: Prevents Windows from auto-installing or forcing the New Outlook web wrapper.
sideEffects: None known.
uiEquivalentLocation: Outlook App › Try the new Outlook toggle

name: Scrollbars Always Visible
description: If enabled, scrollbars will always be visible. If disabled, Windows will automatically hide scrollbars when not in use.
whatItDoes: Always displays full scrollbars in Windows 11 apps instead of hiding them until hovered.
sideEffects: None known.
uiEquivalentLocation: Settings › Accessibility › Visual effects › Always show scrollbars

name: Multiplane Overlay Workaround
description: Workaround for specific display-flicker bugs on certain older GPU drivers. Note: Disabling MPO is not a general performance optimization; it increases power usage and disables hardware-level windowed presentation optimizations on modern systems.
sideEffects: Workaround for screen flickering; increases DWM power usage and may disable windowed HDR presentation.
whatItDoes: Sets OverlayTestMode to 1 in DWM and DisableOverlays to 1 in GraphicsDrivers to disable Multi-Plane Overlay (MPO).

name: Mouse Acceleration
description: User preference toggle to enable or disable non-linear pointer acceleration curves (Enhance Pointer Precision).
whatItDoes: Disables Windows mouse cursor acceleration curve for consistent 1:1 input.
sideEffects: None known.
uiEquivalentLocation: Settings › Bluetooth & devices › Mouse › Additional mouse settings › Pointer Options › Enhance pointer precision

name: Num Lock on Startup
description: Toggle the Num Lock key state when your computer starts.
whatItDoes: Enables NumLock automatically on the Windows logon screen during startup.
sideEffects: Alters the default state of the NumLock key at system boot; may affect laptop keyboards without dedicated numeric keypads.
uiEquivalentLocation: Control Panel › Ease of Access Center › Make the keyboard easier to use

name: Window Snapping
description: Toggles the window snapping feature when dragging windows.
whatItDoes: Customizes window snapping animations and edge assist behaviors.
sideEffects: Alters how application windows snap to screen borders and zones.

name: S0 Sleep Network Connectivity
description: Toggles network connectivity during S0 Sleep which is low power idle in modern laptops.
whatItDoes: Applies power configuration parameters to mitigate modern standby connected sleep drain.
sideEffects: Alters modern standby network sleep state; behavior depends on laptop motherboard firmware.

name: S3 Sleep
description: Toggles between Modern Standby and S3 Sleep, which cuts off power to the CPU while continuing to refresh the memory.
whatItDoes: Forces legacy S3 sleep state over modern standby (S0ix) in ACPI power settings.
sideEffects: Laptops lacking S3 firmware support may fail to sleep, freeze, or suffer bugcheck crashes upon closing the lid.

name: Settings Home Page
description: Toggles the Home Page in the Windows Settings app.
whatItDoes: Hides the personalized 'Home' recommendations page in Windows 11 Settings.
sideEffects: Settings app opens directly to the System page rather than the Home overview cards.

name: Start Menu Bing Search
description: Toggles Bing web search results in Windows Search.
whatItDoes: Disables Bing web search suggestions in the Windows Start Menu search box.
sideEffects: Start Menu search will only search local applications, settings, and personal files; web queries will not appear.

name: Logon Screen Acrylic Blur
description: Toggles the acrylic blur effect on login screen background.
whatItDoes: Disables acrylic blur effect on the Windows lock and sign-in screen background.
sideEffects: Lock screen sign-in shows a clear background image without acrylic blur distortion.

name: Lock Screen - Disable
description: Skips the lock screen entirely and goes directly to the sign-in screen on boot and wake.
whatItDoes: Disables the swipe/key-press lock screen overlay, presenting the password prompt immediately.
sideEffects: Bypasses the lock screen clock and notifications overlay, jumping directly to user sign-in.

name: Start Menu Recommendations
description: Toggles the recommendations section in the Start Menu. WARNING: This will also disable Windows Spotlight on your Lock Screen as a side effect.
whatItDoes: Disables recommended files and recently opened items in the Windows 11 Start Menu.
sideEffects: The 'Recommended' section of the Start Menu remains empty and will not display recent files.
uiEquivalentLocation: Settings › Personalization › Start › Show recommendations for tips, shortcuts, new apps, and more

name: Sticky Keys
description: Toggles the Sticky Keys, which activate when clicking shift rapidly.
whatItDoes: Disables the accessibility shortcut that triggers Sticky Keys when pressing Shift 5 times.
sideEffects: None known.

name: Taskbar Centered Icons
description: Toggles the Taskbar alignment either to the left or center.
whatItDoes: Sets Windows 11 taskbar icons alignment to the left instead of center.
sideEffects: None known.
uiEquivalentLocation: Settings › Personalization › Taskbar › Taskbar behaviors › Taskbar alignment

name: Taskbar Search Icon
description: Toggles the Search Button on the Taskbar.
whatItDoes: Configures Windows taskbar search box display mode.
sideEffects: None known.
uiEquivalentLocation: Settings › Personalization › Taskbar › Taskbar items › Search

name: Taskbar Task View Icon
description: Toggles the Task View Button in the Taskbar.
whatItDoes: Hides the Task View / virtual desktops button from the Windows taskbar.
sideEffects: Removes the Task View shortcut icon from the taskbar; virtual desktops can still be switched via Win+Tab.
uiEquivalentLocation: Settings › Personalization › Taskbar › Taskbar items › Task view

name: Game Mode
description: Toggles Windows prioritizes gaming performance by allocating system resources to games.
whatItDoes: Toggles Windows Game Mode (AutoGameModeEnabled) in user settings.
sideEffects: Windows Game Mode prioritization will be toggled; may alter background resource balancing during full-screen games.
uiEquivalentLocation: Settings › Gaming › Game Mode › Game Mode

name: Enable Long Paths
description: Toggles support for file paths longer than 260 characters in Explorer.
whatItDoes: Enables Win32 long file path support (overcoming the MAX_PATH 260-character limit).
sideEffects: Allows applications to access paths exceeding 260 characters; legacy 16-bit software may not handle long paths.
sourceQuote: EM\CurrentControlSet\Control\FileSystem LongPathsEnabled (Type: REG_DWORD) must exist and be set to 1 . The registry value will be cache
